title: Secrets, Providers, and Tool Governance
goal: Govern secrets, provider eligibility, model access, tool contracts, budgets, approvals, and evidence before any live external execution can be considered.
userImpact: Founders and operators get a clear enterprise provider/tool governance path without fake live actions or hidden spend.
commandCenterImpact: P136.4 surfaces provider/tool governance state in Command Center as review-only UX with current state, blockers, next action, disabled reason, owner, evidence/activity labels, and cost impact.
safetyImpact: Secret values, provider calls, model calls, tool execution, MCP server startup, agent dispatch, DB/runtime writes, project mutation, deploy, release, export, package, network calls, and spend remain blocked.
costImpact: No provider, model, network, DB service, deployment, export, package, or tool execution spend.
